title: Unique continuation inequalities for the Dunkl-Schrödinger equation via uncertainty principles
summary: In this paper, we establish unique continuation inequalities at two time points for the Dunkl--Schrödinger equation. The proof is based on quantitative uncertainty principles for the Dunkl transform. In particular, we prove that pairs of (\varepsilon,k)-thin sets form strong annihilating pairs for the Dunkl transform, which yields quantitative unique continuation properties for solutions to the Dunkl--Schrödinger equation.
